subject: math
title: Grade 4 Line Symmetry
seo_title: Grade 4 Line Symmetry Worksheets: Free Math Practice with Answer Key (BC Curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 math worksheets on line symmetry for the BC curriculum: test dashed lines, count lines of symmetry in shapes and regular polygons, complete symmetrical pictures on a grid, and find symmetry in letters, numbers, maple leaves and snowflakes. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: A line of symmetry folds a shape into two halves that match exactly. A regular polygon has as many lines of symmetry as sides.
key_sub: A rectangle has 2 lines, not 4: its diagonals do not work. Check across and on slants too, not only up and down.
body_html:
What is a line of symmetry?

A line of symmetry splits a shape into two halves that fit exactly on top of each other when you fold along it. Each half is a mirror image of the other, so it is also called a mirror line.

To test a line, fold a paper copy of the shape, or stand a small mirror on the line. If the mirror shows the whole shape, it is a line of symmetry.

Count every line

Try every way to fold: up and down, across and slanting. A shape can have many lines of symmetry, one, or none.

A regular polygon has all sides equal and all angles equal. It has as many lines of symmetry as sides.

ShapeLines of symmetry
Square4
Rectangle (not a square)2
Rhombus (not a square)2 (corner to corner)
Parallelogram (slanting sides)0
Equilateral triangle3
Isosceles triangle1
Scalene triangle0
Kite1
Isosceles trapezoid1
Regular pentagon, hexagon, octagon5, 6, 8
CircleInfinitely many

Complete a symmetrical picture

Give every shaded square a partner on the other side of the line, the same number of squares away from the line. Count from the line, not from the edge of the grid. Flip the half; do not slide it.

Letters, numbers and real life

Some capital letters have a vertical line, some a horizontal line, some both, and some none. Check across as well as up and down.

Look for symmetry around you: a maple leaf, a butterfly, a snowflake, a stop sign, a hockey rink. You can also see it in art, such as many Northwest Coast First Peoples formline designs.

Worked example

How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?

It is regular and has 6 sides. 3 lines join opposite corners. 3 more join the middles of opposite sides. 3 + 3 = 6.

Answer: 6

Worked example

Is the diagonal of a rectangle (not a square) a line of symmetry?

Fold along the diagonal. The two triangles are the same size, but the corners do not land on each other.

Answer: No. A rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting a rectangle’s diagonals as lines of symmetryFold on a diagonal: the corners stick out. A rectangle has 2
Looking only for vertical linesAlso fold across and on slants. A square has 4 lines, the digit 3 has a horizontal one
Saying a parallelogram has 2 linesIts diagonals cut it in half, but the halves do not fit. It has 0
Thinking equal halves are enoughThe halves must land exactly on each other when folded
Sliding the half when completing a pictureFlip it: each square goes the same distance on the other side
Calling “looks the same upside down” a line of symmetryThat is a turn. N, S and the digit 5 have 0 lines

faq.q: What do Grade 4 students learn about symmetry in BC?
faq.a: Line symmetry is a Grade 4 learning standard in the BC math curriculum. Students find lines of symmetry in shapes, letters and pictures, and complete symmetrical designs using paper folding, mirrors or grid paper.

faq.q: Does a rectangle have 4 lines of symmetry?
faq.a: No. A rectangle that is not a square has 2 lines of symmetry: up and down, and across. Its diagonals split it in half, but the halves do not fit when folded.

faq.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular polygon have?
faq.a: As many as it has sides. An equilateral triangle has 3, a square 4, a regular pentagon 5, a regular hexagon 6 and a regular octagon 8.

faq.q: How can my child practise line symmetry at home?
faq.a: Fold paper shapes and cut paper snowflakes, hold a small mirror on letters and pictures, and look for symmetry in leaves, butterflies and signs. Then try the worksheets and check the answer key together.

items.q: Which dashed line is a line of symmetry?
items.e: Imagine folding each shape on its dashed line. Only in A does one half fit exactly on the other. Others: B: the line is not through the middle; C: the line is not through the middle; D: equal parts, but they do not fit when folded.

items.q: Which dashed line is not a line of symmetry?
items.e: In B the line splits the rectangle into 2 equal parts, but they do not fit when folded. In the other 3 pictures the halves fold exactly onto each other.
In D the line splits the parallelogram into 2 equal parts, but they do not fit when folded. In the other 3 pictures the halves fold exactly onto each other.

items.q: Which dashed line is a line of symmetry?
items.e: Imagine folding each shape on its dashed line. Only in C does one half fit exactly on the other. Others: A: the line is not through the middle; B: equal parts, but they do not fit when folded; D: the line is not through the middle. Remember: the diagonal of a rectangle splits it in half, but it is not a line of symmetry.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
items.e: A rectangle has 2 lines of symmetry: up and down, and across, through the middles of the sides. A diagonal splits it into 2 equal triangles, but they do not fit when folded, so the diagonals do not count.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
items.e: A square has 4 lines of symmetry: one up and down, one across and 2 along the diagonals, from corner to corner. Students often forget the diagonals.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does an isosceles triangle (2 equal sides) have?
items.e: Only the line from the top corner to the middle of the bottom side works: 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle (3 equal sides) have?
items.e: It is a regular shape with 3 sides. Each line of symmetry goes from a corner to the middle of the side opposite. 3 corners, so 3 lines. Do not stop at the up-and-down line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a scalene triangle (no equal sides) have?
items.e: The 3 sides are all different lengths, so no fold makes the halves fit. 0 lines of symmetry.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
items.e: Any straight line through the centre of a circle is a line of symmetry. You could never draw them all, so a circle has infinitely many.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a kite have?
items.e: Only the line from the top corner to the bottom corner works, so a kite has 1 line of symmetry.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rhombus have?
items.e: This rhombus (not a square) has 2 lines of symmetry, both from corner to corner. Lines through the middles of the sides do not work.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a parallelogram have?
items.e: A parallelogram with slanting sides has 0 lines of symmetry. Its diagonals and its middle lines split it into equal halves, but none of them fit when folded.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does an isosceles trapezoid have?
items.e: Only the up-and-down line through the middles of the top and bottom works. Folding across does not, because the top is shorter than the bottom: 1 line.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular pentagon have?
items.e: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as sides. Each line goes from a corner to the middle of the side opposite. 5 sides, so 5 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
items.e: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as sides. 3 lines join opposite corners and 3 more join the middles of opposite sides: 3 + 3 = 6 lines.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does a regular octagon have?
items.e: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as sides. 4 lines join opposite corners and 4 join the middles of opposite sides: 4 + 4 = 8 lines.
Only the line straight up through the middle of the flat side works: 1 line. Folding across puts the curve on the flat side.
An oval has 2 lines of symmetry: one across the long way and one up and down. Slanting lines do not work, because it is not a circle.

items.q: How many lines of symmetry does this cross (all 4 arms the same) have?
items.e: Up and down and across both work, and so do the 2 slanting lines through the inside corners: 4 lines, just like a square.

items.q: Which shape has exactly 3 lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines of symmetry of each shape: A (square) 4 lines, B (isosceles triangle) 1 line, C (equilateral triangle) 3 lines, D (rectangle) 2 lines. So the answer is C.

items.q: Which shape has no lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines of symmetry of each shape: A (parallelogram) 0 lines, B (kite) 1 line, C (rhombus) 2 lines, D (rectangle) 2 lines. So the answer is A.

items.q: Which shape has exactly 1 line of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines of symmetry of each shape: A (rhombus) 2 lines, B (rectangle) 2 lines, C (parallelogram) 0 lines, D (kite) 1 line. So the answer is D.

items.q: Which shape has the most lines of symmetry?
items.e: Count the lines of symmetry of each shape: A (regular pentagon) 5 lines, B (regular octagon) 8 lines, C (square) 4 lines, D (regular hexagon) 6 lines. So the answer is B.

items.q: The line of symmetry runs through the middle of a column. Shade squares to the right of the line to make the picture symmetrical. How many squares will be shaded altogether?
items.e: 10 squares are shaded now. 4 of them sit on the line, so each is its own partner: count them once. The other 6 each need a partner. 6 + 6 + 4 = 16.

items.q: The line of symmetry runs through the middle of a row. Shade squares below the line to make the picture symmetrical. How many squares will be shaded altogether?
items.e: 12 squares are shaded now. 5 of them sit on the line, so each is its own partner: count them once. The other 7 each need a partner. 7 + 7 + 5 = 19.

items.q: The line of symmetry runs through the middle of a column. How many more squares must be shaded to make the picture symmetrical?
items.e: Squares on the line are their own partners. 10 squares are shaded and 4 sit on the line, so 10 − 4 = 6 more squares.

items.q: The line of symmetry runs through the middle of a row. How many more squares must be shaded to make the picture symmetrical?
items.e: Squares on the line are their own partners. 13 squares are shaded and 6 sit on the line, so 13 − 6 = 7 more squares.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter A have?
items.e: Fold A straight down the middle and the 2 slanting sides match: a vertical line. Folded across, the point would land on the open bottom, so there is no horizontal line.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter D have?
items.e: Fold D across the middle: the top half of the curve lands on the bottom half. That is a horizontal line. Folded up and down, the straight side would land on the curve.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter H have?
items.e: H has both: fold it up and down and the 2 posts match; fold it across and the top lands on the bottom. Do not stop after finding the vertical line.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter F have?
items.e: F has no line of symmetry. Folded up and down, the arms point the wrong way; folded across, the top arm has no partner at the bottom.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter T have?
items.e: Fold T straight down the middle and the 2 sides of the top bar match: a vertical line only.

items.q: Which lines of symmetry does the capital letter X have?
items.e: X has both a vertical and a horizontal line. It is taller than it is wide, so the slanting lines do not work.

items.q: This is the digit 8 on a digital clock. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold the 8 up and down: the sides match. Fold it across: the top box lands on the bottom box. 2 lines. It is taller than it is wide, so the corner-to-corner lines do not work.

items.q: This is the digit 3 on a digital clock. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Folded up and down, the 3 is open on the left, so that does not work. Folded across, the top half lands on the bottom half: 1 line, and it is horizontal. Do not look only for vertical lines.

items.q: This is the digit 0 on a digital clock. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: This 0 is a tall rectangle: one vertical and one horizontal line, so 2. It is not a circle, so it does not have infinitely many, and its diagonals do not work.

items.q: This is the digit 5 on a digital clock. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold the 5 up and down or across: the parts never land on each other. 0 lines. A 5 looks the same upside down, but that is a turn, not a fold.

items.q: Which capital letter has a horizontal line of symmetry?
items.e: Fold E across the middle and the top arm lands on the bottom arm. M, T and V have a vertical line instead.

items.q: Which capital letter has no line of symmetry?
items.e: R has no line of symmetry: the leg at the bottom right has no partner. H has 2, A has a vertical one and C has a horizontal one.

items.q: Which capital letter has 2 lines of symmetry?
items.e: O matches when folded up and down and when folded across. A and W have only a vertical line, and E only a horizontal one. Remember to check across as well as up and down.
Fold Y straight down the middle and the 2 arms match. B, D and C have a horizontal line, not a vertical one.

items.q: These are digits on a digital clock. Which digit has a horizontal line of symmetry?
items.e: Fold the 3 across the middle: the top half lands on the bottom half. 2, 4 and 7 have no line of symmetry.

items.q: These are digits on a digital clock. Which digit has no line of symmetry?
items.e: 7 has no line of symmetry. 0 and 8 have 2 lines each. 3 has a horizontal line: do not forget to fold across.

items.q: Mei writes 4 words in capital letters. Which word has a horizontal line of symmetry through the whole word?
items.e: C, O, D and E each have a horizontal line of symmetry, so a fold across the middle of CODE works. TOY, MOON and BOAT each have a letter that does not (T, Y, M, N, A).

items.q: Arjun writes 4 words in capital letters. Which word has a vertical line of symmetry down the middle?
items.e: W and O each have a vertical line, and WOW reads the same from both ends, so a fold down the middle of the O works. BOB and DAD read the same both ways, but B and D only have a horizontal line. N has no line at all.

items.q: On a digital display, which number has a horizontal line of symmetry?
items.e: Both digits must fold onto themselves across the middle. 3 and 8 both do, so 38 does. 85 does not: the 5 has no line of symmetry.

items.q: Hana sees 88 on a digital display. How many lines of symmetry does the whole number have?
items.e: One horizontal line goes across both digits, and one vertical line goes down the gap between them. That is 2 lines for the whole number, not 2 for each digit.

sets.title: Symmetry in real life: maple leaves, butterflies and snowflakes

items.e: Only the line straight down the body works: each wing lands on the wing opposite. Folded across, the big top wings would land on the small bottom wings. 1 line.
Fold it straight down the middle, through the top point and the stem: the points on each side match. Folded across, the stem has nothing to match. 1 line.

items.q: The flag of Canada has a red band at each end and a white square with a red maple leaf in the centre. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold it up and down through the leaf: red lands on red and the leaf on itself. Fold it across: the bands match, but the leaf’s point would land on its stem. 1 line.

items.q: This snowflake has 6 arms that are all the same. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: 3 lines go along pairs of opposite arms, and 3 more go between the arms. 3 + 3 = 6 lines, one for each arm.

items.q: A sea star on a Vancouver Island beach has 5 arms, like this picture. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Each line of symmetry runs down the middle of one arm and between the 2 arms opposite. 5 arms, so 5 lines.

items.q: A stop sign has this shape. Without the word STOP, how many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: It is a regular octagon: 4 lines join opposite corners and 4 join the middles of opposite sides. 8 lines. (With the word on it, it would have none.)

items.q: A yield sign is a triangle pointing down like this. Without any words, how many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: It is an equilateral triangle, just upside down. Each line of symmetry goes from a corner to the middle of the side opposite: 3 lines.

items.q: This is a hockey rink seen from above. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold it along the red centre line: each end matches. Fold it across the long way: the top lands on the bottom. 2 lines. The corner-to-corner lines do not work, because the rink is not a square.

items.q: This is a canoe seen from above. Both ends are the same. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: Fold it across the middle: one end lands on the other. Fold it the long way: one side lands on the other. 2 lines, like an oval.
Folded the long way, the fin on top has nothing below it to match. Folded up and down, the head would land on the tail. 0 lines.

items.q: Ava has a square sheet of origami paper. In how many different ways can she fold it in half so that the two halves match exactly?
items.e: A square has 4 lines of symmetry: up and down, across, and the 2 diagonals. So there are 4 ways.

items.q: Liam folds a beach towel, 2 m long and 1 m wide, from one corner to the opposite corner. Do the two halves match?
items.e: The diagonal splits the towel into 2 equal triangles, but they do not fit on top of each other, because the towel is not a square. A rectangle has only 2 lines of symmetry.

items.q: A Grade 4 class makes a plain rectangular banner for the Terry Fox Run. Mateo says it has 4 lines of symmetry. How many does it really have?
items.e: A rectangle that is not a square has 2 lines: up and down, and across. Mateo counted the diagonals, but they do not work.

items.q: Simran traces a hexagon pattern block. It is a regular hexagon. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
items.e: A regular shape has as many lines of symmetry as sides. 6 sides, so 6 lines: 3 through opposite corners and 3 through the middles of opposite sides.

items.q: Emma draws a triangle with 3 equal sides. She finds the up-and-down line of symmetry and stops. How many lines does it have?
items.e: A triangle with 3 equal sides is regular, so it has 3 lines of symmetry, one from each corner to the middle of the opposite side. Look for slanting lines, not only vertical ones.

items.q: Noah has a paper plate shaped like a circle. How many different fold lines will make the two halves match?
items.e: Every line through the centre of a circle is a line of symmetry, so there are infinitely many. Up and down, across and the 2 diagonals are just 4 of them.

items.q: Chloe folds a sheet of paper in half, cuts a shape along the fold and opens it out. What must be true?
c: The fold is a line of symmetry
It has no lines of symmetry
items.e: Both halves were cut at the same time, so each is the mirror image of the other. The fold is always a line of symmetry. The shape might have other lines too, but it does not have to.

items.q: Owen is making a symmetrical picture on grid paper. A shaded square is 3 squares to the left of the line of symmetry. Where does its partner go?
c: 3 squares to the right of the line
6 squares to the right of the line
items.e: A partner is the same distance from the line on the other side: 3 squares to the right of the line. Count from the line, not from the edge of the grid.

items.q: Zara wants a shape with exactly 1 line of symmetry for her art project. Which shape should she pick?
items.e: An isosceles triangle (with only 2 equal sides) has 1 line of symmetry, down the middle. A square has 4, a rectangle has 2, and a parallelogram has 0.

items.q: Ryan says a regular pentagon has only 1 line of symmetry, because he only looks for up-and-down lines. How many does it have?
items.e: A regular pentagon has 5 sides, so it has 5 lines of symmetry, one from each corner to the middle of the opposite side. Only 1 of them is vertical.
